problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: If your garage door is difficult or impossible to lift, a broken spring is the likely cause. The opener cannot handle the full weight alone.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: A clear separation or gap in the spring coil above your garage door means the spring has snapped. It is visibly broken.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: A door that struggles to open past a few inches, then reverses or stops, often indicates a problem with the springs' tension.
If the cables on either side of your garage door appear loose or have come off their drums, a broken spring is typically the underlying issue.
